title: RQ open machine-readable Renaissance corpus rebuild manifest
description: Manifest for rebuilding and verifying the RQ open corpus snapshot from original upstream sources. Corpus v4 is explicitly not an article source: it may be used only as a legacy comparison/migration aid. This scaffold provides exact snapshot checks and the manifest contract; source-specific harvesters must be migrated into ordered, pinned stages before this manifest is article-final.
source_native_rules: Every article-source stage must point to an original upstream source, not Corpus v4.
Every stage must declare outputs, source_refs, retrieval mode, expected headline rows, expected headline words, and license/access status.
Network stages must pin a release tag, DOI/version, commit hash, dump filename, or dated API query wherever the upstream allows it.
Manual or credentialed stages are allowed, but must say exactly what the human downloads and where it is placed before transform.
Corpus v4-derived files may be used only for comparison against the new source-native rebuild, never as the source of article counts.
